Use <nowiki>{{Creature|Sceetler}}</nowiki> or <nowiki>{{Creature|Nightmare}}</nowiki> for a portrait and linked creature name.

Use a canonical creature title, not an ID or filename. Spaces, underscores and first-letter normalization are supported. Unknown names, NPCs, namespaces and section fragments produce an error. A creature without portrait art displays its name link.

Automatic category member labels remain plain links.
